caseData.headline: Worth a look: the borrower has debt it has not disclosed

findings.plain: the borrower has debt it has not disclosed
the borrower is connected to undisclosed shell companies

signals.explanation: 'Keystone Services LLC' looks like a shell: same address as borrower, formed 4 months ago, no LEI / not in GLEIF
'Bluebonnet Asset Finance LP' holds a lien on the borrower ('Keystone Finance Inc': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed (filed before onboarding: may be a stale filing)
Undisclosed related company 'Keystone Services LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified
